Pride and Progress News-highlights: 1. Georgetown University The Human Rights Commission 2. New San Francisco "poppers" legislation 3. Gay man wins case, kills man in self defense after a year of harassment and physical abuse 4. Gay and lesbian counseling service and United Liquors seventeen thousand dollar grant 5. Jim Flint, President of Prairie State Democratic Club, announces entrance into Democratic Primary as Cook County Commissioner 6. "How to Lobby your Legislature" part two with Jim Levin, New York City Human Rights Commissioner COMMERCIAL: CASIO Pocket TV 7. San Francisco Health Department Task Force recommends abortions for pregnant women with AIDS 8. Seramin does not treat AIDS 9. New York hospital faces heavy penalties for mistreating persons with AIDS 10. Job discrimination and AIDS 11. Atlanta Man sets computer to call right winged conservative Jerry Falwell's toll free number every thirty seconds for eight months after anti-gay remarks, each call cost two dollars COMMERCIAL: "New York Native" with Quentin Crisp 12. Healthline: Conversations with GMHC: Robert Bolton, volunteer on GMHC hotline, discusses involvement in program 13. Closing credits
